shots.text: We walked back up the Rift road. When the last of us was through, the six Wardens shut the Black Gate and sealed it with their oath. It has not opened since.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The six Wardens at the foot of the Gate, pushing it shut; the gap closing with a boom that shakes the Rift.

shots.text: Every town we had held was still standing, and its people went home.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Montage: Emberfolk at the forges of Kethra; Galeborn tents at Aurvanis; Pearlhaven's fleet coming home; Stoneborn opening Grundhallow; Veilwalkers relighting Lamplight; Sylvaine planting Elowen's seed in a Solenne garden.

shots.text: We buried Fennick under the east gate he held, and Seraphel beside the Sunstone.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Tamsin, alive, sitting on the rebuilt east gate with Fennick's spectacles; Seraphel's glass sword set into the Sunstone's frame. Oswin, grey and old again, beside her.

shots.text:
I am Ysolde, Queen of Solenne. I am old now, and I have never seen a dawn since.

But I have felt every one of them.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde, older, grey hair, still blindfolded, on the walls of a rebuilt Solenne, sun on her face. Credits roll.
